title: Snipe-IT
name: snipe-it
description: IT asset manager for keeping track of laptops, licences, accessories and consumables: who has what, check-outs and check-ins, audits, maintenance, depreciation and asset tag labels. Source: https://github.com/grokability/snipe-it

env.name: SNIPEIT_URL
env.label: Address you'll open it on (required)
env.description: Exactly what you'll type in the browser, port included and no slash at the end, like http://192.168.1.20:8300. Every page and link is built from it.

env.name: SNIPEIT_APP_KEY
env.label: App key (required)
env.description: Exactly 32 characters. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 16. Keep it the same when you redeploy.

env.name: SNIPEIT_TIMEZONE
env.label: Timezone
env.description: For the dates it shows, like Europe/London.

env.name: SNIPEIT_PORT
env.label: Host port for the web UI

note: Fill in the address, app key and database password before you deploy, since the stack won't start without them. The address has to be exactly what you'll type in the browser, like http://192.168.1.20:8300: the port you're using, and no slash at the end. Snipe-IT builds every page, link and redirect from it, so if it's wrong the front page sends you off to that address instead, and any page you do reach has no styling and buttons that go nowhere. To fix it, change the address in the stack's environment variables and redeploy. Then open the address straight away, as whoever finishes the setup wizard first becomes the admin. There are no sign-ups, the admin adds everyone else under Users. Nothing gets emailed until you add SNIPEIT_MAIL_HOST, SNIPEIT_MAIL_USER, SNIPEIT_MAIL_PASSWORD and SNIPEIT_MAIL_FROM (the address it sends from) to the stack's environment variables and update the stack, plus SNIPEIT_MAIL_PORT if it isn't 587. Uploads and backups live in the snipeit-data volume, everything else in db-data. Docs: snipe-it.readme.io
